# Workflow parameters

`NextPyper`'s internal parameters are governed by a central YAML configuration file (`config.yaml`). While default settings should work well for most target capture datasets, advanced users can customize them to their needs. 

---

## Modifying the configuration

To modify default parameters:

1. Generate a copy of the default configuration file in your project directory using [`nextpyper config`](../../docs/commands/Prepare-inputs/config.qmd):
   ```bash
   nextpyper config --output my_outdir
   ```
2. Edit `my_outdir/config.yaml` with your desired parameter adjustments.
3. Specify `--output my_outdir` when running  `NextPyper` to use your custom config file:
   ```bash
   nextpyper run --output my_outdir ...
   ```

---

## Default `config.yaml` reference

Below is the active default configuration template used by `NextPyper`:

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from pathlib import Path

# Read the YAML file contents
yaml_path = Path("../../../nextpyper/config/config.yaml")
yaml_content = yaml_path.read_text()

# Format as a Markdown code block
markdown_snippet = f"```yaml\n{yaml_content}\n```"

print(markdown_snippet)
```
